Great Barrier Reef Longitudinal Field Log (2008-2021)

2008 | Site: Lizard Island North | Mean summer SST anomaly: +0.4C | Reef condition: Stable hard coral cover | Notes: Baseline transects established; no manipulative interventions conducted.
2009 | Site: Lizard Island North | Mean summer SST anomaly: +0.5C | Reef condition: Stable with minor algal increase | Notes: Tagging of a small number of coral colonies for repeat observation.
2010 | Site: Heron Reef East | Mean summer SST anomaly: +0.6C | Reef condition: Mild paling in isolated patches | Notes: Water quality sampling increased after runoff event.
2011 | Site: Heron Reef East | Mean summer SST anomaly: +0.7C | Reef condition: Recovery in tagged patches | Notes: Researchers deferred shading trial due to permit review concerns.
2012 | Site: Orpheus Reef South | Mean summer SST anomaly: +0.8C | Reef condition: Moderate bleaching in branching corals | Notes: Non-contact imaging adopted to reduce handling.
2013 | Site: Orpheus Reef South | Mean summer SST anomaly: +0.9C | Reef condition: Partial mortality in shallow transects | Notes: Debate recorded over whether biopsy sampling burden was justified.
2014 | Site: Davies Reef Central | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.0C | Reef condition: Patchy bleaching and reduced juvenile recruitment | Notes: Team emphasized limiting diver contact and anchoring near plots.
2015 | Site: Davies Reef Central | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.1C | Reef condition: Prolonged stress before peak summer | Notes: Experimental nutrient exposure proposal rejected as too ecologically disruptive.
2016 | Site: Lizard Island North | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.4C | Reef condition: Severe bleaching across multiple transects | Notes: Emergency monitoring prioritized over manipulative experiments.
2017 | Site: Lizard Island North | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.3C | Reef condition: High coral mortality; low recovery in shallow zones | Notes: Researchers adopted stop-rules for invasive sampling during peak heat stress.
2018 | Site: Heron Reef East | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.0C | Reef condition: Mixed recovery; some resilient colonies observed | Notes: Assisted recovery discussions stressed permit limits and uncertainty of intervention benefits.
2019 | Site: Orpheus Reef South | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.2C | Reef condition: Recurrent bleaching in previously affected sections | Notes: Cumulative disturbance from repeated visits flagged in field ethics memo.
2020 | Site: Davies Reef Central | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.5C | Reef condition: Extensive bleaching and fish assemblage shifts | Notes: Teams instructed to use least-invasive monitoring methods wherever possible.
2021 | Site: Heron Reef East | Mean summer SST anomaly: +1.1C | Reef condition: Uneven recovery; disease lesions observed in some colonies | Notes: Data-sharing recommended to avoid redundant sampling across institutions.
